description: Reference requests for the Plectrum agent's catalogue search. Each request is phrased as an application team would ask it, not with the component's own keywords. A case passes when one of anyOf is in the first three results and every allOf id is in the first five. A case with none: true passes when no Plectrum component scores as a match (the answer is PrimeNG or a new local component). knownMisses lists the cases that do not pass today; any other case that fails is a regression and fails the Plectrum pull request. To accept a regression on purpose, add its case here in the same pull request.
